title: [ML] fix possible race condition in frequent item sets aggregation

timeline.author: Hendrik Muhs

timeline.body:
Refactorings done in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/94023. improved memory management but also made it possible to run into a race condition in `DelegatingCircuitBreaker`. This change makes DelegatingCircuitBreaker thread-safe.

This change is a quick-fix with low risk. Eventually `DelegatingCircuitBreaker` should be removed. Work on that is underway: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/89437. Under that circumstances the change is reasonable to me. The added locking overhead shouldn't be a problem, re-allocations happen rarely and there is just the `disconnect` case where 2 threads potentially access the structure at the same time.

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/94023 hasn't been part of a release, therefore I mark this as non-issue, although technically this is a bug.

fixes #95681

Is it enough if the threads just finish?
Or should there be some assertion in the end checking the value of estimate bytes?

reply.body:
the purpose of the test is not hitting this line: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/4602570fda5a5d7d67f2bdb798767e12c515eb19/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/common/breaker/PreallocatedCircuitBreakerService.java#L109

I was able to re-produce the CI issue with  `-Dtests.iters=1000` - but I don't want to check-in a loop.

Still, I should document ^this, will do.
